name: Transcription Skill
description: Speech recognition: audio/video in, structured Transcript (segments, optional word timestamps, language, provenance) and SpeechEvent candidates out. Not an agent, not a subtitle renderer, not a media analyzer.

engines.description: Whisper via CTranslate2, running locally on CPU/GPU. Reference local engine.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: Haas-ja-v1.0 (Japanese FastConformer-TDT, NeMo) via haas-asr, running locally on an NVIDIA GPU. Optional engine: Linux + CUDA + Python 3.11+ only; Japanese only; custom vocabulary.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B with Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B word timestamps (Apache-2.0), via qwen-asr on a CUDA GPU or the CPU. Optional engine: Python 3.10+; 11 languages with word timestamps; never downloads at run time.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: speech.cpp (C++ on ggml) through its `speech` command: ReazonSpeech v2, parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja and Haas-ja-v1.0 for Japanese and parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 for 25 European languages, with word timestamps, and Qwen3-ASR in 30 languages, on Metal, Vulkan or the CPU with no Python and no CUDA. Optional engine: needs `speech` 0.10.0+ on PATH and models fetched with `speech pull`; recognizes by silero-vad regions; never downloads.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: whisperX: Whisper (faster-whisper) batched over voice-activity regions, with wav2vec2 forced alignment for word timestamps. Optional engine: Python 3.10+, English and Japanese; no diarization.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

tools.name: transcription/transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file into a validated Transcript.

input.word_segmentation: engine | dictionary (dictionary: language ja and word_timestamps true; needs the optional [ja] extra)
input.speaker_turns: diarization-skill/turns@1 document | path | null (merged after recognition, never cached)
input.chunk_seconds: 30..3600 | null (chunked long recording, cut at pauses; needs language)
input.parallel: 1..8 (chunks recognized at a time; chunk_seconds only)
input.speech_regions: media-analysis-skill speech_regions response | result | observation | path | null (chunk_seconds only)

tools.name: transcription/segments
tools.description: Derive SpeechEvent-compatible candidates from a Transcript (one per segment, optional gap merge).

tools.name: transcription/export
tools.description: Render a Transcript as json, srt, vtt, tsv or txt (plain timed text, no styling).

tools.name: transcription/speakers
tools.description: Fill segments[].speaker_id (and words[].speaker_id) of a Transcript from diarization-skill speaker turns (diarization-skill/turns@1), with diarization-skill's own ASSIGN rule. No diarization here. Follows diarization-skill's speaker-id assignment rule and passes its conformance fixtures at the version in `rule`.

tools.name: transcription/find
tools.description: Find a phrase in one or more Transcripts: every hit with its start and end, segment ids, word indices, speaker_id and neighbouring text. Exact, then normalized matching (NFKC width folding, casefold, long vowel marks, whitespace and punctuation ignored, across word and segment boundaries), then optional approximate matching labelled with its ratio. A read-only query: no margin, no cut range, no ranking.

input.fuzzy: 0.5..1.0 | null (approximate matches with ratio >= fuzzy; phrase of at most 64 characters after folding)

output.hits: list[{source, transcript_id, match: exact|normalized|approximate, ratio, start, end, timing: word|segment, segment_ids, word_indices (null when segment-timed), speaker_id, speaker_ids, text, segment_text, context: {before, after}}] (time order within each transcript, transcripts in the order given; empty when the phrase is not spoken)
output.transcripts: list[{source, transcript_id, language, segments, words, word_timed, hits}]

tools.name: transcription/check
tools.description: Validate a Transcript document against the contract.

tools.name: transcription/batch
tools.description: Run many transcription/transcribe requests in one process. One item's failure does not abort the others; each result is reported independently in order.

output.results: list[{ok: bool, result: transcription/transcribe output} | {ok: bool, error: {code, message, details}}]

side_effects: writes cache under workspace, once per item
